_help: Game modes / worlds used by /hub /survival /resource /rpg /wild, /rtp, the server selector, the HUD and the hub inventory.
NO coordinates here: travel points are the warps.<warp> keys in config/serversetup/coordinates.json (created by /setupcoords apply).
world        : the Multiworld dimension (must exist, see /mw list).
warp         : NeoEssentials warp used for travel. If that warp does not exist yet, players go to the world's own
Multiworld spawn point instead (mw tp <world>), so travel never silently fails.
command      : the simple player command (/survival etc.), null = no command of its own. Changing it needs a server restart.
travel       : "rtp" = travelling to this world (selector, /wild) is a random teleport into it instead of a fixed point.
resource     : id of this mode's resource world (another entry here), or null when the mode has none yet.
parent       : for resource worlds: the mode they belong to (its NPC/menus send players back there).
rtp          : true = /rtp works while the player is IN this world (random spot in the same world).
/rtp is refused everywhere else (hub, RPG World, nether, dungeons...). rtp.* numbers are in coordinates.json settings.
wild         : /wild (from ANY world, also the RPG World and the hub) = random teleport into the world of mode wild.target.
The RPG NPC Kael the Wayfinder runs /wild, so he sends players into that world too.
player_warps : true = players may set player warps (/pwarp set) in this world (never inside someone else's claim).
Player warps in other worlds are not allowed and are not shown in /pwarp menu.
selector_*   : how the entry looks in the server selector (icon = item id, slot = chest slot 10-34 inside the border).
